piecewise-partitions.question: How can I reuse branch results without losing jumps?
piecewise-partitions.expected: The image is [-1,0) union [2,3]; the owned spike breaks strict order.
piecewise-partitions.interpretation: A complete cell cover is separate from global order and derivative-root completeness.
piecewise-partitions.limits: Source holes and unresolved seams can prevent partition completion.

finite-metric-proofs.question: Can I certify an optimal finite bound and a total variation?
finite-metric-proofs.expected: The finite constant is 2, the spike variation is 22, and both supplied proofs replay.
finite-metric-proofs.interpretation: All finite pairs and all owned excursions contribute. A changed total is rejected.
finite-metric-proofs.limits: Interval derivative bounds can be useful without the finite replay contract.

algebraic-coefficients.question: How do I keep an algebraic coefficient on its intended real conjugate?
algebraic-coefficients.expected: The image is (0,sqrt(2)); a canceled source hole has empty image at its excluded point.
algebraic-coefficients.interpretation: The rational generator guard selects a unique real embedding.
algebraic-coefficients.limits: The compositum degree is at most four, with at most four nonrational constants and no extra coefficient parameters in the lift.

parameter-geometry.question: How many distinct real roots does a polynomial family have?
parameter-geometry.expected: The demonstrated quadratic strata have counts 2, 1 and 0; the partial frontier resumes to completion.
parameter-geometry.interpretation: Counts refer to distinct roots and exact guarded regions, including degree loss.
parameter-geometry.limits: Degree is at most four in the root coordinate, with up to four real parameters and rational interval endpoints. Transcendental families are outside this interface.

branch-recipes.question: Do my selected local solutions agree on every overlap?
branch-recipes.expected: The compatible square-root recipes glue; opposite selected recipes disagree; crossing branches stay unresolved.
branch-recipes.interpretation: Agreement at one anchor does not prove equality of local formulas.
branch-recipes.limits: This assembles supplied recipes for entire implicit relations; it does not discover arbitrary implicit branches.

certified-extrema-bounds.question: Can I bound extrema without solving the stationary equation exactly?
certified-extrema-bounds.expected: Both value brackets have width at most 1/10000, while exact extrema remain unresolved.
certified-extrema-bounds.interpretation: Value accuracy can be certified without a closed-form stationary coordinate.
certified-extrema-bounds.limits: The supported finite smooth branches and interval enclosures do not cover arbitrary nonsmooth inputs.

branch-chart-gluing.question: Can local logarithms cover a loop without a global logarithm?
branch-chart-gluing.expected: The logarithm has full chart coverage and an obstruction; the selected square root of z**2 glues.
branch-chart-gluing.interpretation: Logarithm sheet transitions and power multipliers have different completion conditions.
branch-chart-gluing.limits: Finite log/power atlases do not supply a general chart-aware contour grammar.

implicit-common-orders.question: Can I prove common zeros and their orders at an implicitly located root?
implicit-common-orders.expected: The local multiplicities are (1,2); this local theorem is not exhaustive root coverage.
implicit-common-orders.interpretation: Exact congruences and nonzero jets establish local orders.
implicit-common-orders.limits: Unproved identities and possible additional zeros keep the corresponding completion fields false.

restricted-domains.question: How do input restrictions and held operations affect an answer?
restricted-domains.expected: The exponential image is (1,E); held x/x excludes zero; positive irrational powers retain zero.
restricted-domains.interpretation: Source definition is tracked before cancellation and before branch rules.
restricted-domains.limits: Holding cannot recover operands already simplified by SymPy before the query.

guarded-piecewise.question: How do parameter guards and singleton branches reach downstream results?
guarded-piecewise.expected: The affine equation has three guarded cases, and the Piecewise maximum is 100 at zero.
guarded-piecewise.interpretation: First-match ownership and parameter hypotheses are mathematical premises.
guarded-piecewise.limits: Unresolved guards or missing seams cannot supply unconditional conclusions.

real-root-coverage.question: When is a real-root count exhaustive?
real-root-coverage.expected: The compact exponential has one root; the repeated polynomial has two distinct roots of total multiplicity six.
real-root-coverage.interpretation: Open endpoints, periodic indexed families and tail proofs complete different parts of the domain.
real-root-coverage.limits: A compact root count cannot cover an infinite domain without exhaustive families or tails.

complex-isolation.question: Does my complex result isolate roots individually at the requested accuracy?
complex-isolation.expected: Three sine zeros and two non-real exponential zeros are counted; a retained cluster is valid partial evidence.
complex-isolation.interpretation: Coverage, individual isolation and requested box accuracy are separate claims.
complex-isolation.limits: The native route requires its declared parameter-free grammar, rational rectangles and clear outer boundary.

algebraic-roots.question: How does the algebraic backend preserve principal branches and holes?
algebraic-roots.expected: A cubic zero has multiplicity three; a held hole removes a candidate; sqrt(z) has unresolved source multiplicity.
algebraic-roots.interpretation: Candidate coverage and source multiplicity use separate contracts.
algebraic-roots.limits: Exact root locations do not automatically establish source multiplicity for radicals.

quotients-and-holes.question: Which counted points are source zeros, excluded extension zeros or poles?
quotients-and-holes.expected: The held cancellation has zero source roots and extension multiplicity two; the examples have zero and one pole.
quotients-and-holes.interpretation: Original denominator restrictions survive meromorphic extension.
quotients-and-holes.limits: Unknown shared orders or unclear boundaries prevent the corresponding complete ledger.

budgets-and-resume.question: What can I retain when a bounded search stops?
budgets-and-resume.expected: An unresolved real seed resumes to one root; the cofinal quotient seed retains its unresolved region.
budgets-and-resume.interpretation: A resource limit stops a search without proving exclusion.
budgets-and-resume.limits: Checkpoints are trusted same-environment records, not a durable untrusted-file format.

newton-refinement.question: Can I shrink a root box without discarding its complement?
newton-refinement.expected: Five child/complement regions preserve total zero count one.
newton-refinement.interpretation: Certified contraction accelerates an already checked local count.
newton-refinement.limits: A small candidate box alone does not prove isolation or discard the surrounding region.

replay.question: Can I check a native proof with its proposer disabled?
replay.expected: The original proof replays; the altered total and foreign source fail.
replay.interpretation: Registered concrete proof types bind the theorem to its original context.
replay.limits: Factory-based and algebraic routes have their own declared replay dependencies.

local-branches.question: How does a selected logarithmic germ affect a local residue?
local-branches.expected: The selected residue is I*pi; removing the branch context fails replay.
local-branches.interpretation: A local germ supplies source-bound branch values at a particular point.
local-branches.limits: A local branch calculation is not a global principal-branch identity.

unsupported-and-partial.question: How should I interpret unsupported or unfinished isolation?
unsupported-and-partial.expected: The unresolved seed and boundary obstruction retain unknown totals and incomplete status.
unsupported-and-partial.interpretation: Successful local replay does not assert exhaustive coverage.
unsupported-and-partial.limits: Unsupported grammar and unclear boundaries are neither root-exclusion proofs nor mathematical counterexamples.
